method: Viewed source artwork, producer masks/contact sheets, independently extracted native-resolution motion crops and last-two/first-two seam frames. Fully decoded all 84 frames of each video and independently recomputed adjacent-frame, seam, inside/outside-mask and brightness metrics. Verified SHA-256 before/after decode and at report writing.
limitations: No full-speed playback or audio audition performed.
Approval applies only to these exact visual hashes, not integrated product quality or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution cat and fire samples, and last-two/first-two seam crops. Furniture, book spines, stove body, counter, cat face and paws preserve their geometry.

Torso movement is small and consistent with a sleeping cat breathing in sampled frames; fire flicker stays within the stove opening. No obvious duplicate features, rectangular mask boundary or scene-wide light breathing appears in the inspected samples. Fine fur movement remains subtle rather than demanding attention.

Independent full decode reproduces seam ratio 1.6521 and outside-mask change 0.000216 on a 0–255 channel scale. Cat seam samples preserve the resting pose; changing flame shape resembles normal flicker.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA sampled visuals and independent full-decode metrics; no full-speed playback or audio audition
findings: Viewed source artwork, mask/contact sheet, eight native-resolution central-window, foliage and mug samples, and last-two/first-two window seam crops. Glass bars, pots, mug rim, books, table and architecture remain stable.

Motion behind the central glass is restrained; foliage and mug effects are very subtle. The sampled window and mask edges show no obvious rectangle, doubled structure or exposure jump. The composed scene remains calm, though full-speed viewing is needed to judge whether rain movement reads naturally rather than as a subtle animated texture.
Independent full decode reproduces seam ratio 2.7048 and outside-mask change 0.000122 on a 0–255 channel scale. Last/first window samples show no obvious geometry reset or framing jump.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed playback and audition integrated ambience.
